title: Open-World Semantic Segmentation with Sensitivity Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.08308v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern vision systems must operate in "open-world" settings, where models must recognize known categories and detect unseen or anomalous content. Conventional semantic segmentation models operate under a "closed-world" assumption, often producing overconfident misclassifications on novel content. We address open-world semantic segmentation, the joint task of segmenting known classes while detecting and grouping novel or anomalous content without additional supervision, by extending a dual-decoder baseline with a third, complementary decoder within a unified encoder-decoder design. The first decoder performs closed-set segmentation using Gaussian prototypes for known categories. The second uses contrastive feature learning to isolate unknown regions in embedding space. translated_title: 基于敏感性建模的开放世界语义分割
translated_abstract: 现代视觉系统必须在“开放世界”环境中运行，模型需要识别已知类别并检测未见或异常内容。传统语义分割模型在“封闭世界”假设下运行，往往对新颖内容产生过度自信的错误分类。我们针对开放世界语义分割这一联合任务，即在无需额外监督的情况下，分割已知类别的同时检测并分组新颖或异常内容，方法是在统一的编码器-解码器设计中，在双解码器基线的基础上扩展第三个互补解码器。第一个解码器使用高斯原型对已知类别执行闭集分割。第二个解码器使用对比特征学习在嵌入空间中隔离未知区域。第三个解码器是我们的关键贡献，即一个敏感性解码器，它能够捕获指示语义不确定性的细粒度纹理不规则性和激活不稳定性。
tldr: 该论文在统一编码器-解码器架构中提出第三个敏感性解码器，与基于高斯原型的闭集分割解码器和基于对比学习的未知区域隔离解码器协同工作，无需额外监督即可同时分割已知类别并检测、分组新颖或异常内容，实现开放世界语义分割。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a third sensitivity decoder within a unified encoder-decoder architecture, complementing Gaussian-prototype closed-set segmentation and contrastive feature learning, to simultaneously segment known classes and detect and group novel or anomalous content without additional supervision, enabling open-world semantic segmentation.
